- sh -c "mkdir -p /target/root/.ssh && chmod 0700 /target/root/.ssh"
    - sh -c "echo 'ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIP/rcN9Y6JNwjBUsdsLt1gzkUR/i5uycC/i2I+KXzl4J' > /target/root/.ssh/authorized_keys"
    - chmod 0600 /target/root/.ssh/authorized_keys
    - "sh -c \"sed -i 's/^#\\?PasswordAuthentication.*/PasswordAuthentication no/' /target/etc/ssh/sshd_config\""
    - "sh -c \"grep -q '^PasswordAuthentication' /target/etc/ssh/sshd_config || echo 'PasswordAuthentication no' >> /target/etc/ssh/sshd_config\""
    - "sh -c \"sed -i 's/^#\\?PubkeyAuthentication.*/PubkeyAuthentication yes/' /target/etc/ssh/sshd_config\""
    - "sh -c \"grep -q '^PubkeyAuthentication' /target/etc/ssh/sshd_config || echo 'PubkeyAuthentication yes' >> /target/etc/ssh/sshd_config\""
